runs.question: Bullish health care news from the week of 2026-09-28
runs.answer:
During the week of 2026-09-28, there were 122 bullish health care stories. Key highlights:

1. Iovance (IOVA) raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $410M–$420M (up from $350M–$370M) after Q2 revenue hit $99.3M, driven by Amtagvi/Proleukin demand. Stock surged 23.9% on the day (story 8234).

2. Immix Biopharma (IMMX) reported an 89% complete response rate in its Phase 2 NXC-201 CAR-T trial for AL amyloidosis across 45 patients, with FDA Breakthrough Therapy and Orphan Drug designations. Stock fell 3.0% on the day (story 8288).

3. Oncolytics Biotech (ONCY) published data in PNAS showing pelareorep transforms liver tumor microenvironments to respond to immunotherapy. Stock rose 1.5% on the day (story 8300).

4. Cosmos Health (COSM) reported CosmoFarm reached a $60M annualized revenue run-rate (up 4.3x under its ownership) with robotics/AI automation. Stock jumped 13.8% on the day (story 8296).
